info.title: Doctor Tracker API
info.description: Backend release candidate: sessions, approval, management, assignments, clinical care, private notes, role-scoped analytics and filter metadata. Timestamps are UTC; calendar dates use Asia/Dhaka. Every mutation requires a session-bound CSRF token. All authenticated data and documentation are private, no-store. Public exceptions: health, CSRF bootstrap, registration and login. Pending/rejected sessions may read auth/me and log out but cannot access portal data. Hosted acceptance is required before the v1.0.0 release.

get.summary: Read the active account’s role-specific dashboard
get.description: Identity comes exclusively from the session. from/to are inclusive Asia/Dhaka YYYY-MM-DD dates. to defaults to today; from defaults to 29 calendar days before to. Maximum 365 inclusive calendar days. Daily buckets through 90 days, monthly afterward; month labels use the first day of the month, with partial boundary months counting only the requested dates. Missing buckets and all five statuses are zero-filled. Totals/statuses describe all current records/assignments regardless of range; trends describe stored records/current assignments, not visits or historical assignment snapshots. Admin totals count each patient once; top ten doctors include zero-patient doctors and tie by ID; use GET /doctors for paginated details. Doctor recent assignments are the latest ten, independent of range. Patient response has own clinical fields and at most ten linked-doctor summaries (latest first); use GET /me/doctors for pagination. Date parameters are validated but do not affect the patient response. No private notes are returned.

get.description: field defaults to condition. Admins may request specialization, hospital, condition or status. Doctors may request condition/status and only values from their currently assigned patients contribute to records or totals. Patients are forbidden. Values and labels use normalized exact-filter keys; absent/empty fields are omitted. Options are deduplicated and sorted ascending, with escaped literal normalized prefix search. Default page=1 and limit=20, maximum limit=100. Totals count permitted matching unique options, never hidden records. No frequency counts are exposed.

get.description: Retain the cookie. Supply the token as X-CSRF-Token for every mutation. Login regenerates the session and invalidates the old token; fetch this endpoint again after login. Safe for pending/rejected sessions. Browser Origin or Referer, when supplied, must match FRONTEND_ORIGIN exactly. No credentialed cross-origin CORS is enabled; browser clients use the frontend same-origin proxy.

post.summary: Register an active patient account or submit a doctor account for approval
post.description: Patients receive an active account and linked unassessed patient profile immediately. Doctors receive a pending account without a profile and require admin approval. Does not log in. Existing profile emails are not automatically linked. Requires a previously established CSRF session. Only doctor/patient roles and the listed fields are accepted. Ten attempts per IP per fixed one-hour window.

put.summary: Approve or reject a pending registration (active admin only)
put.description: A decision is final in v1. Approve with mode=create or mode=link and an explicit matching-email, unclaimed profileId. Create uses submitted fields. New patients require patientClinical with condition and status; use an empty condition string to confirm no condition. Doctor decisions reject patientClinical. Linking preserves existing profile data. Approval and profile linkage/creation are atomic. Duplicate or competing decisions return 409. Rejection retains the submission and optional reason.
